Mott MacDonald is currently looking for a Landscape Architect in Dubai, to grow their Landscape Architecture Team for supporting the delivery of projects.
r: Support to create strong conceptual and technical landscape design throughout the full scope.
Translate concepts into detailed designs, support senior staff in creating functional and visually compelling spaces.
Develop plan layouts, sections, and elevations graphically and technically in hand sketches & computer environment with an eye for precision and clarity.
Work and coordinate with a multi-disciplinary team, take on tasks independently.
Assist developing grading plans that ensure functional, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing landscapes.
Support continuous improvement and digital ways of working, sharing knowledge and lessons learned.
Demonstrate safe, ethical and inclusive behaviours aligned to Mott MacDonald values.
A degree in Landscape Architecture from an accredited university.
Good knowledge of plant species, horticulture, and sustainable design practices.
Fluent in written and verbal communication.
Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, etc.)
Ability to do clean and presentable hand sketches

We’re looking for a Purchasing & Inventory Officer to manage procurement and inventory operations end-to-end in Riyadh.
This role plays a key part in ensuring product availability, cost efficiency, and smooth warehouse operations to support our daily production.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field
2–3 years of experience in procurement and inventory roles (F&B or FMCG preferred)
Experience using ERP or inventory management systems
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Screening meeting with our TA team
r: Source and manage suppliers (local & international) for ingredients, packaging, and services
Ensure timely purchasing aligned with production and demand planning
Track supplier performance, pricing, and cost-saving opportunities
Build strong vendor relationships to ensure consistency and reliability
Stay updated on market trends, especially within the F&B space
Oversee stock control, storage, and inventory accuracy
Maintain real-time inventory records and reduce discrepancies
Ensure proper implementation of FIFO / FEFO practices
Monitor expiry dates, batch tracking, and stock movement
Ensure compliance with food safety and warehouse standards (HACCP)
Work closely with kitchen and production teams to forecast needs
Support material planning and daily stock issuance
Track key KPIs (stock turnover, wastage, availability)
Support audits and continuous process improvements
